name: midnight-features
title: Midnight product tiles
author: Vilqor <https://vilqor.com>
description: A product section built from interface fragments instead of icons: a research list, a sentence with numbered sources in tooltips, and three facts shown as a schedule, a switch and language codes.
docs:
The block takes its words as props; the types sit at the top of the file. Name the theme in the same command, for example: npx shadcn@latest add https://midnight-lite.vilqor.com/r/midnight-theme.json https://midnight-lite.vilqor.com/r/midnight-features.json. A theme that only comes in as a dependency adds its colours but keeps your existing --background, --primary and fonts. If the page is not night-blue, run: npx shadcn@latest add https://midnight-lite.vilqor.com/r/midnight-theme.json. Works with the Radix and the Base UI styles of shadcn/ui; React Aria (aria-nova) is not supported yet. No TooltipProvider needed: each source badge brings its own.
The full Midnight template, with seven more sections, forms and analytics: https://templates.vilqor.com/midnight?ref=shadcn
